mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, reward, deadline, status, publisher_id AS publisherId, create_time AS createTime FROM task WHERE status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0 AND deadline > NOW() ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task ( title, content, reward, deadline, status, publisher_id, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{reward}, #{deadline}, #{status}, #{publisherId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.content, t.reward, t.deadline, t.status, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.is_deleted, t.version, t.publisher_id AS publisherId, t.taker_id AS takerId, u_pub.nickname as publisher_nickname, u_taker.real_name as taker_real_name FROM task t LEFT JOIN user u_pub ON t.publisher_id = u_pub.id LEFT JOIN user u_taker ON t.taker_id = u_taker.id WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET taker_id = #{takerId}, take_time = NOW(), status = 1, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0 AND version = #{version}
